options.name: bmc_proxy
options.description: BMC Smart proxy for this subnet

options.name: boot_mode
options.description: Boot mode used by hosts in this subnet

options.name: ca_path
options.description: PEM formatted file that contains a CA certificate to be used for validation. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(FOREMAN_CA_PATH) will be used instead.

options.name: cidr
options.description: CIDR prefix length; Required if I(network_type=IPv4) and no I(mask) provided

options.name: description
options.description: Description of the subnet

options.name: dhcp_proxy
options.description: DHCP Smart proxy for this subnet

options.name: discovery_proxy
options.description: Discovery Smart proxy for this subnet This option is only available if the discovery plugin is installed.

options.name: dns_primary
options.description: Primary DNS server for this subnet

options.name: dns_proxy
options.description: Reverse DNS Smart proxy for this subnet

options.name: dns_secondary
options.description: Secondary DNS server for this subnet

options.name: domains
options.description: List of DNS domains the subnet should assigned to

options.name: externalipam_group
options.description: External IPAM group for this subnet. Only relevant if I(ipam=External IPAM).

options.name: externalipam_proxy
options.description: External IPAM proxy for this subnet. Only relevant if I(ipam=External IPAM).

options.name: from_ip
options.description: First IP address of the host IP allocation pool

options.name: gateway
options.description: Subnet gateway IP address

options.name: httpboot_proxy
options.description: HTTP Boot Smart proxy for this subnet

options.name: ipam
options.description: IPAM mode for this subnet

options.name: locations
options.description: List of locations the entity should be assigned to

options.name: mask
options.description: Subnet netmask. Required if I(network_type=IPv4) and no I(cidr) prefix length provided

options.name: mtu
options.description: MTU

options.name: name
options.description: Subnet name

options.name: network
options.description: Subnet IP address

options.name: network_type
options.description: Subnet type

options.name: oauth1_consumer_key
options.description: OAuth1 consumer key for accessing the Foreman server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(FOREMAN_OAUTH1_CONSUMER_KEY) will be used instead.

options.name: oauth1_consumer_secret
options.description: OAuth1 consumer secret for accessing the Foreman server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(FOREMAN_OAUTH1_CONSUMER_SECRET) will be used instead.

options.name: organizations
options.description: List of organizations the entity should be assigned to

options.name: parameters
options.description: Subnet specific host parameters

options.name: password
options.description: Password of the user accessing the Foreman server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(FOREMAN_PASSWORD) will be used instead.

options.name: remote_execution_proxies
options.description: Remote execution Smart proxies for this subnet This option is only available if the remote_execution plugin is installed. This will always report I(changed=true) when used with I(remote_execution < 4.1.0), due to a bug in the plugin.

options.name: server_url
options.description: URL of the Foreman server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(FOREMAN_SERVER_URL) will be used instead.

options.name: state
options.description: State of the entity

options.name: template_proxy
options.description: Template Smart proxy for this subnet

options.name: tftp_proxy
options.description: TFTP Smart proxy for this subnet

options.name: to_ip
options.description: Last IP address of the host IP allocation pool

options.name: updated_name
options.description: New subnet name. When this parameter is set, the module will not be idempotent.

options.name: use_gssapi
options.description: Use GSSAPI to perform the authentication, typically this is for Kerberos or Kerberos through Negotiate authentication. Requires the Python library L(requests-gssapi,https://github.com/pythongssapi/requests-gssapi) to be installed. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(FOREMAN_USE_GSSAPI) will be used instead.

options.name: username
options.description: Username accessing the Foreman server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(FOREMAN_USERNAME) will be used instead.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether or not to verify the TLS certificates of the Foreman server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(FOREMAN_VALIDATE_CERTS) will be used instead.

options.name: vlanid
options.description: VLAN ID
